1. Claim 15 (Currently amended): A method for selecting an edge server computer from a plurality of server computers in a computer network to send data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: providing a locator of a resource on a second server computer, the locator including a unique signature identifying the resource and __information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers, wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server performance metrics including at least one of server load, server availability, or network latency__; receiving the locator at the client computer; and selecting the first server computer from the first set of server computers based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that analyzes the real-time server performance metrics to determine an optimal server computer for fulfilling the data request__.

2. Claim 16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and determines the first server computer based on analysis of the real-time server performance metrics at the time of the http request__.

3. Claim 17 (Original)

4. Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __and the real-time server performance metrics, wherein the selection occurs prior to transmitting the data to the client computer__.

5. Claim 24 (Currently amended): A system for selecting an edge server computer from a plurality of server computers in a computer network to send data to a client computer, the system comprising: a second server computer having a locator of a resource, the locator including a unique signature identifying the resource and __information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers, wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server performance metrics including at least one of server load, server availability, or network latency__; a client computer for receiving the locator; and __a media request broker comprising circuitry for selecting the first server computer from the first set of server computers based on the information and the real-time server performance metrics__.

6. Claim 25 (Currently amended): The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker comprises circuitry for receiving the http request and determining the first server computer based on analysis of the real-time server performance metrics at the time of the http request__.

7. Claim 27 (Currently amended): A computer program product for selecting an edge server computer from a plurality of server computers in a computer network to send data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising a computer-readable storage medium having program instructions stored thereon, the program instructions comprising: instructions for providing a locator of a resource on a second server computer, the locator including a unique signature identifying the resource and __information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers, wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server performance metrics including at least one of server load, server availability, or network latency__; instructions for receiving the locator at the client computer; and instructions for selecting the first server computer from the first set of server computers based on the information and __the real-time server performance metrics, wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker__.

8. Claim 28 (Currently amended): The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the computer program product further comprising the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and determines the first server computer based on analysis of the real-time server performance metrics at the time of the http request__.
